title: Resource management and scenario analysis
summary: Conceptual approaches to the systematic consideration of available resources, possible courses of action and their effects.

text: Development of conceptual approaches to the systematic consideration of available resources, possible courses of action and their effects.
The analysis serves to compare different scenarios in a transparent way, take risks into account and present decision options in a structured form.
Independently developed conceptual approach to analysing resources, risks and courses of action.
